## Checklist

- [ ] The change is on a branch, not on `main`
- [ ] `scripts/verify.sh` passes locally
- [ ] Commits follow the conventional format and each one is a single logical change
- [ ] Behaviour changes carry a test
- [ ] Documentation or the changelog is updated when behaviour changes
- [ ] No case data, run artefacts, credentials or machine paths are committed
